description: Preview or apply changes to an existing brand's canonical token source. Use it when editing a brand; use brand_create to create one. Returns validation, changed slots, before/after hashes and build evidence. delta is required and supports aliases or add/remove/replace patches. apply defaults to a dry run that writes nothing. apply:true validates first, then writes source and rebuilds; build failure leaves source edits in place. For shipped brands in the portable runtime, apply emits a review kit and reports source/build steps as skipped. User brands rebuild in their own folder. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#brand_apply; full schema: oods://schemas/brand_apply.input.json.

brand.description: Target brand identifier. Must name a brand directory under packages/tokens/src/tokens/brands.

delta.description: Alias changes (object) or an array using the supported add/remove/replace subset of RFC 6902 when strategy=patch.

verbosity.description: full includes structured before/after payloads; compact returns summary + hunks only.

strategy.description: Alias strategy rewrites token values; patch applies the supported add/remove/replace subset of RFC 6902.

name: brand_apply
title: Apply Brand Changes
